name: Alt Text Generator AI – Automatically generate alt text for images using AI
author: Bryam Loaiza

sections.description:
Alt Text Generator AI writes descriptive, SEO-friendly alt text for your WordPress images automatically, so every image on your site is accessible and discoverable without typing a single description by hand.

Over 50% of websites are still missing alt text on their images, and ADA-related web accessibility lawsuits have topped 3,100 filings in a single year. Missing alt text is more than a lost SEO opportunity in Google Image Search. It is a real accessibility and legal risk.

Get a free API key at the AltTextGeneratorAI Dashboard and start generating alt text in minutes. New accounts include 2 free credits to try it out.

Four ways to generate alt text

  1. Automatically on upload – Alt text is written the moment an image finishes uploading to the Media Library. On by default, and you can switch it off in Settings.
  2. One click in the Media Library – Open any image and click Generate Alt Text to create or regenerate its alternative text.
  3. In bulk – The Bulk Alt Text page scans your whole library and sorts images into Empty, Short (under 20 characters) and All tabs. Search by ID or text, generate for selected images, or generate for everything in the tab.
  4. From the command line – Use wp alt-text generate to process an entire library with WP-CLI.

Why Alt Text Matters

  • SEO – Google uses alt text to understand and rank your images in Image Search, which can drive organic traffic to product pages, blog posts and galleries.
  • Accessibility – Alt text lets screen readers describe your images to visually impaired visitors, a core requirement of WCAG 2.1/2.2.
  • Legal compliance – ADA and Section 508 website-accessibility lawsuits are rising every year. Properly described images reduce that exposure.

Key Features

  • Automatic generation on upload – Alt text is automatically added to every image uploaded on the site.
  • One-click generation in the Media Library – A Generate Alt Text button sits right under the Alternative Text field in the image details window.
  • Bulk Alt Text page – Generate alt text in bulk for all of the images on your WordPress site.
  • Fully editable – Every generated alt text is editable, so you can review and edit.
  • Auto-Fill Image Details – Automatically generate the image title, caption, and description using the generated alt text.
  • 131+ languages – Generate alt text in your site’s language, from English, Spanish, French, German, Chinese, Japanese and Arabic to Swahili, Zulu, Welsh, Yiddish, Maori and many more. Full list below.
  • WP-CLI Automation – Run alt text generation directly from WP-CLI with commands like wp alt-text status and wp alt-text generate, ideal for migrations, staging-to-production workflows, and scheduled jobs.
  • Credits and API status at a glance – See your remaining credits and API connection status on the Settings page.
  • Extensive image support – JPEG, JPG, PNG, SVG, GIF, WEBP and AVIF.
  • WooCommerce Ready – Automatically generate alt text for product and gallery images without any extra setup.
  • WCAG and ADA compliant – Helps your images meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 and ADA accessibility requirements, including Success Criterion 1.1.1 (Non-text Content).
  • Pay-as-you-go credits – Buy credits once and use them whenever you need—credits never expire, and every AltTextGeneratorAI integration is included. See pricing.

Supported Languages (131)

Afrikaans, Albanian, Amharic, Arabic, Armenian, Assamese, Aymara, Azerbaijani, Bambara, Basque, Belarusian, Bengali, Bhojpuri, Bosnian, Bulgarian, Catalan, Cebuano, Chinese, Corsican, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dhivehi, Dogri, Dutch, English, Esperanto, Estonian, Ewe, Filipino, Finnish, French, Frisian, Galician, Georgian, German, Greek, Guarani, Gujarati, Haitian Creole, Hausa, Hawaiian, Hebrew, Hindi, Hmong, Hungarian, Icelandic, Igbo, Ilocano, Indonesian, Irish, Italian, Japanese, Javanese, Kannada, Kazakh, Khmer, Kinyarwanda, Konkani, Korean, Krio, Kurdish, Kyrgyz, Lao, Latin, Latvian, Lingala, Lithuanian, Luganda, Luxembourgish, Macedonian, Maithili, Malagasy, Malay, Malayalam, Maltese, Maori, Marathi, Meiteilon (Manipuri), Mizo, Mongolian, Myanmar (Burmese), Nepali, Norwegian, Nyanja (Chichewa), Odia (Oriya), Oromo, Pashto, Persian, Polish, Portuguese, Punjabi, Quechua, Romanian, Russian, Samoan, Sanskrit, Scots Gaelic, Sepedi, Serbian, Sesotho, Shona, Sindhi, Sinhala (Sinhalese), Slovak, Slovenian, Somali, Spanish, Sundanese, Swahili, Swedish, Thai, Tajik, Tamil, Tatar, Telugu, Tigrinya, Tsonga, Turkish, Turkmen, Twi (Akan), Ukrainian, Urdu, Uyghur, Uzbek, Vietnamese, Welsh, Xhosa, Yiddish, Yoruba, Zulu.

Using WP-CLI

The plugin registers an alt-text command with two subcommands. Run them from your WordPress root folder (the one containing wp-config.php). The plugin must be active, with your API key and domain saved in AltTextGenerator → Settings.

Commands

  • wp alt-text status – Shows API status, remaining credits, website domain, language and how many images are missing alt text.
  • wp alt-text generate – Generates alt text for every image that has none.

Options for wp alt-text generate

  • --short – Also regenerate images whose alt text is shorter than 20 characters.
  • --all – Regenerate every image in the library, even if it already has alt text.
  • --ids=<ids> – Only process these attachment IDs (comma-separated).
  • --force – With --ids, regenerate even if the image already has alt text.
  • --limit=<number> – Process at most this many images in one run.
  • --dry-run – List the images that would be processed without calling the API or using credits.

Examples

# Check API status, credits, and how many images are missing alt text
wp alt-text status

# Generate alt text for every image that's missing it
wp alt-text generate

# Also regenerate images whose alt text is too short
wp alt-text generate --short

# Regenerate every image in the library
wp alt-text generate --all

# Regenerate specific attachments, even if they already have alt text
wp alt-text generate --ids=12,34,56 --force

# Preview what would be processed, without using any credits
wp alt-text generate --limit=20 --dry-run

Each generated image uses one credit. Run wp alt-text status first to check your balance, and --dry-run to preview large jobs.

Who It’s For

  • Bloggers and publishers who don’t have time to hand-write hundreds of descriptions.
  • WooCommerce stores that need consistent, SEO-ready alt text across large product catalogs.
  • Agencies and freelancers managing alt text across multiple client sites.
  • Any site owner who wants to meet WCAG/ADA accessibility expectations without manual work.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New and search for Alt Text Generator AI, or upload the plugin zip.
  2. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Visit the AltTextGeneratorAI Dashboard to create a free account and copy your API key.
  4. Open AltTextGenerator → Settings in the WordPress sidebar. Paste your API key, enter your website domain, choose your language and click Save Settings.
  5. Done. Upload an image and alt text is generated automatically. To process your existing library, use AltTextGenerator → Bulk Alt Text or run wp alt-text generate.

Need a walkthrough? Follow the WordPress setup tutorial or watch the video.
sections.faq:
What is alt text, and why does my WordPress site need it?

Alt text (alternative text) is a short description attached to an image. Screen readers read it aloud to visually impaired visitors, and search engines use it to understand what an image shows. Without it, images are invisible to assistive technology and to Google Image Search, and your site risks falling short of WCAG/ADA accessibility requirements.

Does this plugin generate alt text automatically, or do I have to trigger it?

Both. Alt text is generated automatically when you upload a new image (you can turn this off in Settings). For existing images, use the Bulk Alt Text page to generate descriptions for everything that is missing one, or open any image and click Generate Alt Text.

Can I edit the alt text the AI generates?

Yes. Every alt text is editable. You can edit it at any time from the Media Library or from the Bulk Alt Text page.

What counts as “short” alt text on the Bulk page?

Alt text under 20 characters, for example a bare file name or a single word. The Short tab lets you find and regenerate these in bulk.

Can I also generate other image details?

Yes, you can generate the image title, caption, and description using the generated alt text. Check the options on the Settings page.

How many languages does it support?

131 languages, from major world languages to regional ones. Pick your language in Settings.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Product and gallery images are processed the same way as any other image, which helps your product pages rank in image search.

What image formats are supported?

JPEG, JPG, PNG, SVG, GIF, WEBP and AVIF.

Do I need a paid plan to try it?

No. New accounts get 2 free credits to test the plugin on real images. When you need more, credit packs are one-time purchases that never expire. See the pricing page.

Can I generate alt text from the command line?

Yes. The plugin registers a wp alt-text WP-CLI command, including wp alt-text generate and wp alt-text status. See “Using WP-CLI” above for examples.
sections.changelog:
2.4.6

Added AVIF support: AVIF images are converted to JPEG on your server before alt text is generated (requires GD or Imagick with AVIF support on your host). Error responses from the API (for example an invalid key or no credits) are no longer saved as alt text. The Bulk Alt Text tab counts now include every image type.

2.4.5

New WP-CLI options: wp alt-text generate --short also regenerates images with short alt text, and --all regenerates every image in the library.

2.4.4

The Generate Alt Text button now appears right away when you open an image from the Bulk Alt Text page, with no need to click away and back.

2.4.3

In the Media Library image window, the Generate Alt Text button now sits below the Alternative Text description and lines up with the field.

2.4.2

Fixed row dividers in the Bulk Alt Text table so action buttons stay aligned.

2.2.2 – 2.4.1

  • New Settings page with welcome banner, credits and API status cards, a “Need more credits?” card and a Resources card with the setup tutorial and video.
  • New brand colors across Settings, Bulk Alt Text and the Media Library button.
  • New sidebar menu with Settings and Bulk Alt Text submenus and a new icon.
  • Credits now refresh automatically, including when you return to the tab.
  • Bulk Alt Text lists update immediately after an image is generated, so tabs no longer show stale data.
  • Generation on upload now only runs for images, so other file types never use a credit.
  • Smaller buttons and a cleaner language dropdown.

2.2.1

Fixed the Bulk Alt Text page’s row action buttons being hidden until hover (caused by a CSS class name that collided with a WordPress core admin style). Made the admin menu icon’s background transparent and fixed its vertical centering. Standardized button heights across Settings and Bulk Alt Text so they’re all the same size. Increased the banner’s border contrast.

2.2.0

Expanded language support from 35+ to 131+ languages. Added an “Automatically generate on upload” setting (on by default) so automatic generation can be turned off. Redesigned the Bulk Alt Text page with Empty/Short/All tabs, search, and a sortable table. Fixed a sidebar icon sizing issue and a stale-cache issue that could leave the Bulk page stuck on “Loading images…”. Various styling fixes (button sizing, language dropdown).

2.1.0

Added WP-CLI support: wp alt-text generate (with --ids, --force, --limit, --dry-run) and wp alt-text status.

2.0.0

Rewrote the plugin description, features, and FAQ for accuracy and clarity. Updated the supported-language list to match all 35+ languages available in the settings page. Confirmed compatibility with the latest WordPress release.

1.10.3

New promo video.

1.10.2

New screenshots and fixed small info text.

1.10.1

Improved styling and added bulk feature.

1.10.0

Changed listing information.

1.0.9

Edited listing features.

1.0.8

Added feature to generate alt text in 35 different languages.

1.0.7

Added SVG support.

1.0.6

Moved “Generate Alt Text” button below alt text field.

1.0.5

Fixed bugs.

1.0.4

Moved button to be positioned below alt text content area.

1.0.3

Fixed styling for generate alt text button.

1.0.2

New button added to generate alt text from media section.

1.0.1

Tested up to WordPress 6.6.

1.0.0

Initial version.
